rule_en: Second conditional = unreal or unlikely present/future: If + past simple, would + base. With 'be', use 'were' for every person: If I were you.
rule_bn: অবাস্তব বা কাল্পনিক পরিস্থিতি → If + past simple, would + base। 'be' হলে সব person-এ 'were': If I were you.

sessions.title: Spot the Error
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the wrong word, then choose the fix.

items.prompt_en: If I would have more time, I would automate this report
items.explain_en: No 'would' in the if-clause: If + past simple.

items.prompt_en: If she was the team lead, she would cancel half these meetings
items.explain_en: Unreal 'be' takes 'were' for every person.

items.prompt_en: If we had a bigger budget, we will hire two more engineers
items.explain_en: An unreal result → would + base, not 'will'.

items.prompt_en: I would took the remote job if they offered better pay
items.explain_en: 'would' takes the base verb: would take.

items.prompt_en: If I am you, I would rewrite that trigger from scratch
items.explain_en: 'If I were you' is the fixed advice pattern.

items.prompt_en: If the org would allow it, we would test directly in production
items.explain_en: The if-clause takes the past simple, never 'would'.

items.prompt_en: She would travels more if her project had less on-call duty
items.explain_en: The base verb follows 'would': would travel.

items.prompt_en: If we don't had legacy code, releases would take a day
items.explain_en: An unreal negative: didn't + base in the if-clause.

items.prompt_en: What will you do if you won the lottery tomorrow?
items.explain_en: An unlikely dream → second conditional: would + base.

items.prompt_en: If our app would crash less, support tickets would drop fast
items.explain_en: Keep 'would' out of the if-clause — past simple instead.

sessions.title: Choose & Fill
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the correct option or chip.

items.prompt_en: If I ___ the CTO, I would freeze new features for a month.
items.explain_en: An unreal role: 'were' for all persons.

items.prompt_en: If we ___ TypeScript, we would catch these bugs at compile time.
items.explain_en: If + past simple for the unreal condition.

items.prompt_en: She ___ for a startup if the salary weren't so risky.
items.explain_en: An unreal result → would + base.

items.prompt_en: What ___ you change if you owned this codebase?
items.explain_en: A hypothetical question → would.

items.prompt_en: If my laptop ___ faster, these builds wouldn't hurt so much.
items.explain_en: An unreal state with 'be' → were.

items.prompt_en: If I had three monitors, I ___ so many windows.
items.explain_en: Unreal result: would/wouldn't + base.

items.prompt_en: If you ___ any language, which one would you master?
items.explain_en: The second conditional uses 'could' as the past of 'can'.

items.prompt_en: He would say yes if you ___ him directly.
items.explain_en: The if-clause takes the past simple.

items.prompt_en: If I ___ you, I would take the certification this quarter.
items.explain_en: The fixed advice pattern: If I were you.

items.prompt_en: If the meeting were optional, half the team ___ .
items.explain_en: An unreal situation → wouldn't + base.

sessions.title: Build It
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the tiles in the right order. For speak items, say it out loud.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If I had more RAM , this build would fly .
items.explain_en: If + past simple, would + base.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If I were you , I would ask for a raise .
items.explain_en: The advice pattern: If I were you, I would …

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: She would sleep more if the pager stayed quiet .
items.explain_en: Result clause first: would + base, then if + past simple.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If bugs fixed themselves , we would lose our jobs .
items.explain_en: An imaginary situation → second conditional.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: I would travel for a year if money were no problem .
items.explain_en: Unreal 'be' → were, even after 'money'.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If the office had a gym , he would go every day .
items.explain_en: If + past simple sets up the unreal condition.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: We would hire her if the budget allowed it .
items.explain_en: would + base in the result, past simple after 'if'.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If this query were faster , the page would load instantly .
items.explain_en: Unreal state → were; unreal result → would + base.

items.prompt_en: Say what you would do if you didn't have to work tomorrow.
items.model_en: If I didn't have to work tomorrow, I would sleep in and then go for a long walk.

items.prompt_en: Give a teammate advice using 'If I were you'.
items.model_en: If I were you, I would split that pull request into two smaller ones.
